# `project.disclosure`

[project](../README.md) · disclosure

WHAT THIS BUNDLE PERMITS TO BE PUBLISHED OUT OF ITS OWN DATA. A bundle-level POLICY statement, in the same idiom as `conformance.out_of_scope`: a claim plus the reason for it, made once, in the manifest, where a reader and a gate both find it — never per page and never per concept, because a per-page switch is a per-page mistake. Distinct from `capabilities` (what the container CAN do) and from `publish` (where output GOES): this says what the bundle's own rows are allowed to become. CLOSED (`additionalProperties: false`) so a second disclosure question is a schema change with a record rather than a key somebody adds on a Tuesday.

### `samples`

*object* · optional · [has its own keys →](samples.md)

MAY THE ROWS THEMSELVES BE RENDERED ON A GENERATED PAGE? The sampler (tools/mac_sample.py --plane concepts) draws a seeded random sample of each concept's MEMBERS into data/samples/concepts/. Whether those rows may be RENDERED to a reader — the console's Sample view, or any other surface that shows them — is this key's decision. The rendered concept page carries no rows: the operator ruled the sample belongs on its own view and not on the page, so the semantic page stays semantic. That is safe for a bundle over synthetic data and it is a data leak for a bundle over customer data — and the two bundles produce the SAME PAGE from the same code, so the difference cannot live in the projector. It lives here. DEFAULT WITHHELD, and a bundle that says nothing withholds: the harm is asymmetric (a withheld sample costs a reader one convenience; a published one cannot be recalled), and the measured shape is concrete — one live bundle's raw preview already trips the public-repo leak gate on a real organisation name, and the same page in a customer bundle would publish forty customer rows. WITHHOLDING IS NOT SILENCE: the page still renders the section, still says a sample exists, and still states the member count. Absent altogether, this key means withheld, which is why it is optional and why no bundle turns red for lacking it.

Its own keys: [`project.disclosure.samples`](samples.md)
